caption: A ring magnet is dropped down a pencil standing upright toward another ring magnet at the base with like poles facing, and it stops and floats a little above the lower one.

sa.check: A pencil stands upright with a ring magnet at its base.
A second ring magnet is dropped down the pencil.
The falling ring stops above the lower one.
The upper ring floats with a gap above the lower one.
The falling ring is threaded onto the pencil.
The order is drop, slow, hover.

pc.expect: The upper ring falls down the pencil, slows as it nears the lower ring and comes to hover with a visible gap above it; it does not land on it.
pc.fail: The upper ring lands on the lower ring and rests there; or the upper ring rises back up the pencil; or it hovers high up the pencil far from the lower ring; or the lower ring rises to meet it.

pc.expect: The hovering ring bobs and settles at a steady height with the pencil through its centre; it stays there while nothing touches it.
pc.fail: The upper ring passes through the gap and the lower ring; or flies off the pencil; or its bobbing grows until it flies up; or it settles and then drops onto the lower ring with nothing touching it.

pc.expect: The upper ring travels straight down along the pencil, staying threaded on it.
pc.fail: The ring leaves the pencil and falls beside it; or tilts and jams then continues through the pencil; or spins off sideways; or moves upward at first.

pc.expect: The pencil stays upright and still; the lower ring stays at the base; the table does not move.
pc.fail: The pencil topples or slides; or the lower ring slides up or off; or the table shifts; or the pencil spins.

pc.expect: Two rings threaded on one pencil; the rings stay outside the pencil and each other; the pencil stays solid.
pc.fail: A ring passes through the pencil's side; or the rings merge into one; or a third ring appears; or a ring passes through the table.

pc.expect: The rings' colours, the pencil and the table stay the same.
pc.fail: A ring changes colour or size; or the pencil changes colour or length; or the table changes.
